channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🌐 GoDaddy Domain Manager by Bruce Young
item.description: Manages your domains at GoDaddy and its reseller storefronts like LuckyRegister: renewals, DNS, nameservers, forwarding, and locks. It's read-only until you approve each change.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: ✂️ FilmCraft Video Editor by Bruce Young
item.description: Cleans up short AI-generated videos (morphing, weird turns, popping limbs, jumpy cuts) using the free open-source FilmCraft editor and ffmpeg, by cutting, retiming and adding holds and transitions, without regenerating footage. For creators making AI films and shorts.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 🔍 Lead Finder by Bruce Young
item.description: Finds people who are publicly asking for what you sell across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, forums, and job boards, logs them in a Google Sheet, and drafts a helpful first message for the best ones. Built for salespeople and side-business owners; you send everything yourself.
item.dc:creator: Bruce Young (@ecoay)

item.title: 👑 Empire Commander by John
item.description: One lead bot for people running several Grok Bots: it interviews you, keeps one job list, and asks before anything goes out.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🌿 420 Terp Bot by John
item.description: A science-nerd guide to cannabis terpenes for adults 21+ and budtenders, built only on public lab data. Get strain picks, side-by-side lab charts, label reads and a personal taste map.
item.dc:creator: John (@iamtheh0n3yp0t)

item.title: 🛰️ Release Scout by AJ
item.description: Reads the Grok Bot changelog every morning and tells you what's new for the bots you already run, including any change that could affect them. It suggests specific upgrades that use new features, and it never changes your bots on its own.
item.dc:creator: AJ Ghergich (@SEO)

item.title: 👩‍🏫 Training Tina by Jim
item.description: Builds simple tech lessons for seniors and beginners: 3-minute video scripts, one-page large-print cheat sheets and gentle quizzes for Windows, Office, iPhone, Android and staying safe from scams. For family helpers, volunteers, librarians, church and senior-center teachers, and small computer shops.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 💰 Profit Piper by Jim
item.description: A research-first helper for dropshipping and simple online stores. It tests whether a niche or product can make real profit, with live sources, honest unit economics, draft store pages and small test plans, and never spends, publishes or contacts anyone without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🩹 First Aid Freddie by Jim
item.description: A calm, warm first aid helper for everyday cuts, burns, stings and "should we go in?" moments. Gives short steps from trusted free sources, helps you choose between home care, urgent care, the ER or 911, and keeps your first aid kit ready. General information, not medical advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🚀 Freelance Gig Launcher by Jim
item.description: Helps you pick a freelance service clients actually buy, then drafts a Fiverr gig or Upwork project: title, tags, packages, description, FAQs, and fee math so you know what you'll keep. Drafts only: you publish everything yourself.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: ✉️ Complaint Desk by Jim
item.description: Turns a bad-purchase story into a firm, polite complaint letter with a clear ask and a deadline, then shows the next step if the company stalls: a card or bank dispute, CFPB, FTC, your state attorney general, BBB, FCC or DOT. Drafts only: you send, file and sign everything yourself. General information, not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Jim (@jimaggie)

item.title: 🔐 Cloud IAM Quarantine Advisor by Igor
item.description: Finds over-privileged or risky Google Cloud service accounts and drafts least-privilege fixes and an emergency quarantine runbook. Dry-run only until you approve.
item.dc:creator: Igor Holt (@holt_igor)

item.title: 📡 Bot Radar by Steve Thoms
item.description: Keeps a live map of every Grok Bot marketplace and directory site and sends a regular report of new bots across them, deduped and ranked by how widely they're spreading. For anyone who wants to keep up with new Grok Bots without checking a dozen sites.
item.dc:creator: Steve Thoms (@thomstech12)

item.title: 💳 SaaS Spend Check by Calix
item.description: Shows every tool you're paying for and where you may be overpaying. It reads subscription receipts in connected Gmail or Outlook, or a pasted statement, and lists each tool, cost, renewal, and source receipt. Read-only: never cancels, pays, or contacts vendors. Flags duplicates, price jumps, upcoming renewals, and unused seats.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🛡️ Anti-Adfraud Bot by Markus
item.description: Explains click fraud and fake leads on Google Ads in plain language, walks you through a 10-question self-check, and points you to a free audit. Provided by adfraudit.com.
item.dc:creator: Markus (@adfraudit)

item.title: 🤝 Negotiation Sparring Partner by Kevin
item.description: A negotiation coach that plays the other side (hiring manager, landlord, contractor, car dealer) with real pushback, then scores your moves and builds a one-page game plan for the real conversation.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏘️ New Town Insider by Kevin
item.description: A local-knowledge guide for people relocating. Name your new town and it builds a briefing from official sources on permits, zoning, schools, trash days, utilities, registrations, and tax deadlines, citing the city or county page for every rule.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌙 Quiet Health Companion by Kevin
item.description: A private, no-nag health companion. Log sleep, mood, energy, symptoms, and meds in a few words or a photo, and it quietly spots patterns, sends a short weekly note, and builds a one-page summary for your doctor.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📞 Voice Clone Defense by Kevin
item.description: Helps families guard against AI voice-clone and deepfake scam calls with a private code question, a calm call-back script, a printable card for grandparents and kids, and practice drills.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🛡️ AI Agent Permission Auditor by Kevin
item.description: Shows what your AI apps, assistants, browser extensions, and bots can see and do, flags access that's too broad, stale, or overlapping, and walks you through trimming it in each app's own settings. It never changes settings itself or asks for passwords.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤖 Home Robot Onboarding Coach by Kevin
item.description: Gets your home and family ready for a household robot, whether it's a robot vacuum, lawn robot, security robot, or humanoid helper. It maps safety zones, sets camera and microphone privacy rules, builds a starter schedule, explains the robot to kids, and lists the questions to ask your insurer.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔍 Real or AI Checker by Kevin
item.description: Checks whether a photo, video, audio clip, screenshot, document, or link might be AI-generated or altered before you share it or act on it, and gives a plain confidence rating with reasons.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚕 Robotaxi vs. Car Ownership Advisor by Kevin
item.description: Figures out whether your car is worth keeping by comparing the true cost of ownership with robotaxis, rideshare, and other rides where you live. Gives a keep, downsize, or switch call with the break-even point and sourced fare assumptions.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🕊️ Digital Afterlife Planner by Kevin
item.description: Plans what happens to your digital life if you die or become incapacitated: an account inventory with your wishes for each, legacy-contact setup, and a plain-language instructions letter for your estate documents. Never collects passwords or seed phrases.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🔑 Account Lockout Rescue by Kevin
item.description: Helps you get back into a locked Google, Apple, Microsoft, bank, or social account through the provider's official recovery path, then sets up backup codes, passkeys, and a recovery sheet so it doesn't happen again. It never asks for passwords or codes.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🪪 Portable AI Profile Keeper by Kevin
item.description: Keeps one portable file of your preferences, writing style, standing instructions, and project history so you can switch AI assistants without starting over. Imports pasted memories, removes duplicates, and makes a short paste-in version for tools with character limits.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📦 Life Black Box by Kevin
item.description: A flight recorder for your life. It quietly collects your receipts, policies, IDs, photos and medical lists, so after a disaster you say one sentence like "my house flooded" and your whole emergency packet is ready.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚨 Tripwire by Kevin
item.description: A daily pre-mortem for your life. Each morning it looks across your calendar, email, weather, and the things you own, warns you about the one or two things most likely to go wrong today or this week with a two-minute fix, and stays silent when nothing is at risk.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💸 Settlement & Breach Payout Finder by Kevin
item.description: Finds open class action settlements and data breach payouts you may qualify for, with deadlines, proof needed, and payout estimates, and preps claim answers for you to submit on the official site.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🩺 The Botfather by Brandon
item.description: On-demand diagnostic coach for the Grok Bots you actually have. It inspects the deck when you ask, finds issues and data bleed, and hands you a recommendations-and-why document. It does not change anything until you say yes, and it has no standing routine.
item.dc:creator: Brandon Barton (@BrandonBarton26)

item.title: 📱 First Phone Readiness Coach by Kevin
item.description: Helps parents decide if their child is ready for a first phone or smartwatch, then set it up well with parental controls, a family phone agreement, and 30-day check-ins.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌱 Lawn & Garden Calendar by Kevin
item.description: A friendly yard and garden planner that builds a month-by-month calendar for planting, fertilizing, mowing, watering, pruning, and frost protection, tuned to your hardiness zone and forecast. It answers quick lawn questions in plain language and can send reminders.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📡 DEX Liquidity Radar by Igor
item.description: Plain-English liquidity and volume alerts for tokens and pools you watch, from public DEX data. Read-only: no wallets, no trades, not financial advice.
item.dc:creator: Igor Holt (@holt_igor)

item.title: 🔌 MCP Builder Coach by Igor
item.description: Scaffolds, tests, and documents a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for your API so AI agents can use it.
item.dc:creator: Igor Holt (@holt_igor)

item.title: 📍 Nearby Reminders by Kevin
item.description: A location-based to-do list: tie items to a store, address, or kind of place, and it nudges you when your phone shows you're nearby.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💼 Job Application Desk by Z23
item.description: Finds open jobs that fit you, tailors your resume to each from your real experience, and fills out the applications end to end. You just give the final yes to submit.
item.dc:creator: ZyMoProfit (@ZyMoProfit)

item.title: 🧩 Multi-Agent Collaboration and Selection Strategy by w
item.description: 多 Agent 协作与选型策略: a public playbook for when to split agents and how to spend on models. Don't split by default; copy only after a gold sample; require machine-checkable acceptance tests before self-evolution; spend premium models on hard work. Strategy and tier logic only — no vendor machines, logins, or private schedulers.
item.dc:creator: w

item.title: 🎞️ Knowledge Animation Pipeline by w
item.description: 全程知识动画流水线 takes knowledge animations from topic card and script through a time contract, motion render, independent QA, and delivery. Render, dependencies, and GPU run on your own computer — no vendor machine, login, or GPU included.
item.dc:creator: w

item.title: 🍿 Movie Actor Streak by Troels Jensen
item.description: Planning a few weeks of films with one actor? Type their name and get every feature film they've played in, oldest first, with IMDb and TMDB scores, runtime and where to stream it in your country, on a sortable page you can print as a PDF.
item.dc:creator: Troels Jensen (@TroelsMJensen)

item.title: ✂️ Cut · Film Editor by Wayne
item.description: An AI film director and editor. Send raw clips and Cut pitches a shot list, then cuts an edit with punch-ins, speed ramps and voiceover.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🔎 Clip Scout by Wayne
item.description: Type a word or emotion and get the most recognizable movie and TV reaction clips for your edit, with search strings and tone options.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🧪 Prompt Lab by Wayne
item.description: Writes coding prompts you paste into several AI models to compare how well each one builds something visual in code (Three.js, canvas, SVG, HTML/CSS).
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🪽 Hermes by Wayne
item.description: A front end to the Nous Research Hermes Agent CLI on your computer. It runs your prompts through Hermes, keeps the CLI updated, and returns the results.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: ✨ Glow Up by Wayne
item.description: Send a selfie and get a funny, flattering, over-the-top glam makeover with big hair and dramatic makeup, in vibes like Pageant Queen or Disco.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🎬 Director by Wayne
item.description: Leads a six-bot video production team: routes each video job to the right specialist, keeps one house style, and checks every cut before handing it over.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🥊 Gauntlet by Wayne
item.description: Turns verified AI model test runs into scorecards and 1280x720 gauntlet reels with PASS stamps, a scorebug and a leaderboard.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🎸 Riffrow by Wayne
item.description: MST3K-style riff bot: takes a clip, writes a three-character riff script, voices it, and renders a theater-style video in landscape and vertical.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 📱 Shorts by Wayne
item.description: Makes 35-50s vertical (720x1280) shorts of model tests and highlights: action from frame one, hook in two seconds, verified numbers only.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🆚 Versus by Wayne
item.description: Builds head-to-head comparison videos in one fixed look: focus model on the left, opponents cycling right, STAR WINNER stamps and a running score.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)

item.title: 🖼️ Thumbs by Wayne
item.description: Builds consistent 1280x720 video covers and opening slides with your real photo composited untouched; never AI-generated faces.
item.dc:creator: Wayne Lowry (@wikiwayne)
